name: hamamelis virginiana top water
uses: USES FOR THE TEMPORARY RELIEF OF ANORECTAL DISCOMFORT ASSOCIATED WITH HEMORRHOIDS.
otcwarn: FOR EXTERNAL USE ONLY. IF YOUR CONDITION DOES NOT IMPROVE AFTER 7 DAYS OR BLEEDING OCCURS, CONSULT A DOCTOR . KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN DO NOT INSERT THIS PRODUCT INTO THE RECTUM USING FINGERS OR APPLICATOR. IF CHILDREN UNDER 12 YEARS OF AGE, PREGNANT OR BREAST-FEEDING, CONSULT A HEALTH PROFESSIONAL BEFORE USE.
